key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD smashed on growth scare; oil 'explodes' as price suppression fails, fuel prices +30c
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern, reinforcing rate-hike expectations
ANZ.AX axed 3,500 jobs; banks under pressure amid rising bond yields
Housing prices crashing at high end while affordable segment resilient; first-home buyers surging
Mining sector cap-raise dash led by Canaccord signals capital stress
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy fears; Santos preservation noted
Gold underperforming ('gold schmould') despite geopolitical tensions
Woolworths.WSW breached its own 'Price Freeze' on four staples, hitting consumer confidence

sectors.trend: Severely negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; gold underperforming; cap-raise dash signals capital stress across juniors and majors.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Juniors (PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources, Aruma, Gateway WA) vulnerable to funding gaps. Gold names (Kuniko) lack safe-haven bid.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate-hike fears pressure valuations; ANZ.AX cutting 3,500 jobs signals cost discipline but weakens growth narrative.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM pressure if RBA hikes further. Credit growth may slow. Bond yield rise compresses equity multiples.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive for producers. Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails; Australia softens gas supply rules easing Asian fears. Santos preservation noted as strategic sacrifice.
sectors.implications: Santos.STO, Woodside.WDS benefit from firmer oil/gas. Fuel cost +30c pressures transport and consumer sectors. LNG export flexibility supports revenue.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths.WSW breached Price Freeze; businesses 'fear for their future'; housing crash dampens consumer spending.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WSW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Consumer discretionary under pressure. Housing-linked spend (furnishings, appliances) at risk.

sectors.trend: Divergent. High-end prices hit steepest falls; affordable end resilient. No spring bounce in auctions. RBA worried about rental inflation.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental yield compression. Developer equities under pressure. First-home buyer surge may support volume but not prices.

sectors.trend: Positive globally. Amazon triples NVIDIA GPU orders; ServiceNow AI Control Tower; Delcath, ProKidney, Zura Bio advancing. Limited ASX direct exposure.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from global AI capex cycle. CSL.AX, SSW.AX stable. US-listed healthcare (DCTH, PROK, ZURA) show R&D progress but widening losses.

key_themes: Rate-hike fears and rising bond yields driving broad ASX selloff ($90bn wipeout)
Commodity divergence: oil surging, iron ore collapsing, gold underperforming
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and fuel price pressure
Housing market bifurcation: luxury crash vs affordable resilience
Mining sector capital stress and cap-raise cycle
RBA rental inflation focus complicating rate path
Superannuation policy debate (One Nation, early access) creating political risk
Global AI capex surge (NVIDIA, ServiceNow) as offsetting positive

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / rising bond yields
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour floating-rate and short-duration credit; hedge with gold or inflation-linked bonds
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into energy (Santos, Woodside) or defensive staples
Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor RBA intervention signals
Avoid luxury REITs and developer equities; monitor auction clearance rates and first-home buyer data
Avoid junior miners in active cap-raise; favour cash-flow-positive majors with low leverage
Monitor political risk around One Nation proposals; favour diversified fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX)

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers on oil surge and gas supply flexibility
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails; Australia softens gas rules supporting LNG export revenue; Santos preservation signals strategic support

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to global AI/tech capex cycle via ASX-listed enablers
opportunities.rationale: Amazon triples NVIDIA orders; ServiceNow AI Control Tower; ASX small-caps (Neurizon, Iondrive) showing momentum

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive consumer staples with pricing power
opportunities.rationale: Woolworths breach highlights margin pressure but also pricing power; WES.AX benefits from fuel cost pass-through

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore / thermal coal exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; cap-raise cycle signals structural demand weakness; gold underperforming

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness and rate risk
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; RBA rental inflation focus implies further hikes; bond yields rising

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid high-end property and luxury REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at top end; no auction spring bounce; rental inflation pressure on yields

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as rate-hike fears, iron ore weakness, and AUD depreciation persist. Oil surge provides partial offset via energy names. RBA rental inflation commentary keeps hawkish bias. Expect volatility around ^AXJO and ^AORD.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction at high end may stabilise; AI capex cycle supports tech; energy transition (battery tech, gas flexibility) offers structural themes. Superannuation policy risk remains a wildcard. Iron ore recovery contingent on China stimulus.
